description.value: Sunshine Coast Connector runs a daily scheduled bus along the lower Sunshine Coast, linking the Langdale ferry terminal to Powell River via Earl's Cove, with stops in Gibsons, Sechelt, Roberts Creek, and other communities along Highway 101. Bikes travel on a rack mounted to the bus (no box needed) for CAD $20; e-bikes under 80 lbs are also accepted for CAD $40. Rack space is limited, so reserve your bike or e-bike spot in advance — confirm current fares and space with the operator before travel.

wow_evidence: Scheduled bus along the lower Sunshine Coast between Powell River and the Langdale ferry terminal
